description: Hersteller-ID, product data and the ERiC runtime of this installation.

fields.description: On as long as no runtime is installed or no Hersteller-ID is entered: Prüfen and Testsenden only simulate, nothing reaches the Finanzamt.
fields.label: Simulation Mode

fields.description: Before ERiC is used, the Datenschutzhinweise of the tax administration have to be read and confirmed (§ 5 of the ERiC licence). Their text comes with the ERiC download from the ELSTER developer area. Without the confirmation, only the simulation runs.
fields.label: Datenschutzhinweise Read and Confirmed

fields.description: Five digits, issued to the manufacturer of the software in the ELSTER developer area.
fields.label: Hersteller-ID

fields.description: Goes to ELSTER with every case, at most 50 characters and without the word ELSTER.
fields.label: Product Name

fields.description: Who delivers the data, at most 256 characters: company; contact person; telephone; e-mail; town; postcode; street; country.
fields.label: Datenlieferant

fields.description: Absolute path on the server of the ERiC archive for Linux x86_64, as downloaded from the ELSTER developer area after the login.
fields.label: ERiC Archive

fields.description: The checksum the ELSTER developer area lists for the archive, 64 hexadecimal digits.
fields.label: SHA-256 of the Archive

name: ERiC Settings
